purpose: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: overlapping cylindrical probes with pronounced lengthwise furrows. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: raised-fossil-relief; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim. Compatible oblique views show raised inflated sandstone probes with deep irregular lengthwise furrows and rounded pinching ends on an irregular slab. Concept centered crossings can suggest radial star; freeze three unequal overlapping probes with offset crossing and one short off-center probe, not spokes radiating from one junction. Preserve coherent host support and quiet sandstone regions. Ignore speckle/texture. Relief positive, furrows longitudinal with mild waviness, no transverse annulation or worm anatomy.
